templates.disk_selection: Which disk would you like to test? {disk_choices}
templates.quick_start: I’ll measure small-working-set sequential and 4 KiB QD1 random reads and writes on {disk_name}. The temporary file uses {file_size}, this run writes at most {write_limit}, and the total timeout is {timeout_description}.
templates.quick_result: Quick results for {disk_name}: sequential read {read_speed}, write {write_speed}; 4 KiB QD1 random read {random_read_speed}, write {random_write_speed}. These small-working-set measurements do not confirm sustained post-cache performance. Report: {report_link}
templates.deep_invitation: Would you like a more thorough test? It will use a {file_size} temporary file, write at most {write_limit} in this run, and keep at least {reserve_space} free. {timeout_notice}
templates.total_timeout_notice: This test may take a long time, and its duration is difficult to estimate precisely. We have set the total test timeout to {timeout_minutes} minutes. If that limit is reached, measurements will stop automatically and a report will be generated from the data collected so far.
templates.partial_result: The test partially completed: {measured_summary}. {stop_reason}; {missing_measurements} remain unmeasured. A report has been generated from the available data: {report_link}
templates.capacity_invitation: Would you like to check the capacity and read/write integrity of the available space? This check will cover {check_range}, write an additional {write_limit}, and leave {reserve_space} free. {duration_description}. A drive with falsified capacity may corrupt existing data when written to, so back up important files first. Passing confirms consistency only within the tested file range; it does not prove the entire drive is defect-free or authenticate its brand.
templates.share_invitation: Would you like to make these measurements public for others to reference? {public_data_preview}. You can also include a verified link to your own X account. Only the preview you approve will be submitted; {privacy_summary}.
templates.skill_invitation: If measuring your own disk would help, you can optionally install the DriveSpeed Skill: {skill_url}. Voluntarily shared measurements add citable evidence for other users and for later retrieval and comparison by models and agents. This does not mean a model automatically learns or updates its parameters, and it does not guarantee more accurate answers.
templates.deep_not_recommended: I recommend stopping here for now. {evidence_and_reason}. These results already address {answered_goal}; long writes would add little toward that goal. {remaining_unknowns}. A separate test would be useful if you later need {specific_followup_goal}.
templates.deep_recommended: I recommend a deeper test to investigate {unresolved_question}. {expected_additional_evidence}.
templates.smart_context: SMART data was read at {captured_at}. {capture_scope}. Device identity and SMART values are firmware-reported and may be altered; a passing status does not authenticate the brand or capacity or guarantee reliability.
templates.review_context: These are measurements published by other reviewers. Interface, enclosure, capacity, software and workload differences affect comparability and do not establish a fault or falsification.
templates.privacy_reminder: Check raw JSON and logs for local paths before sharing them.
templates.conversion_context: The copy times in the report are calculated from measured throughput; actual transfers also depend on the other drive and filesystem.
